content.text:
I've updated the draft. Cold space is the binding constraint: the 2–8 °C zone has 2 free pallet positions and zero headroom at maximum delivery. Both peptides (RM-009, RM-010) go in that zone, so the draft caps each peptide delivery at its current maximum (56 kg and 112 kg), requires staggered deliveries, and asks suppliers to quote their delivery frequency and cold-chain handling. It also asks for 9-month minimum shelf life on the peptides and a second-source check.

I set the response deadline to 30 September 2026 as a placeholder, so please confirm or change it.

Do you want me to ask suppliers for smaller, more frequent peptide lots (which keeps the cold footprint inside the current two positions), or should I look at adding cold capacity? Adding capacity would cost about INR 4,500 per pallet per month.
